subject: Mobile app crashes on startup
description: Since installing the latest version, the mobile app crashes within two seconds of opening on both iOS and Android.
resolution: Fixed a startup crash in the mobile app caused by a null config value on first launch. Released a mobile app hotfix.

subject: Mobile app crashes when opening dashboard
description: Tapping into the dashboard tab reliably crashes the mobile app for users on older devices.
resolution: Fixed a dashboard crash in the mobile app caused by an out-of-memory image load. Released a mobile app hotfix.

subject: Mobile app keeps crashing after update
description: Several users report the mobile app crashes repeatedly ever since the last update went out.
resolution: Fixed a crash in the mobile app introduced by the last update's onboarding screen. Released a mobile app hotfix.

subject: Mobile app crashes randomly in background
description: Users say the mobile app crashes after sitting in the background for a while and has to be force-restarted.
resolution: Fixed a background crash in the mobile app caused by a memory leak in the sync worker. Released a mobile app hotfix.

subject: Password reset link doesn't work
description: Customer clicks the password reset link from the email but lands on an error page instead of the reset form.
resolution: Fixed a broken password reset link caused by a malformed token in the reset email template. Resent a working password reset link to the customer.

subject: Password reset link expired instantly
description: Customer clicks the password reset link within a minute of receiving it but it already says 'expired'.
resolution: Fixed the password reset link expiry, which was misconfigured to 60 seconds instead of 60 minutes. Resent a working password reset link to the customer.

subject: Users can't reset their password
description: Multiple users report the password reset form silently fails and their password never actually changes.
resolution: Fixed a validation bug in the password reset form that rejected valid new passwords. Resent password reset instructions to the affected users.

subject: Password reset email delayed by hours
description: Customer requested a password reset and the reset email didn't arrive until three hours later.
resolution: Fixed a backlog in the password reset email queue caused by a stuck worker. Cleared the queue and resent the password reset email immediately.

subject: Duplicate charge on renewal
description: Customer was charged twice for their annual renewal on the same day.
resolution: Confirmed a duplicate charge caused by a race condition in the renewal job. Refunded the duplicate charge and added a lock to prevent concurrent renewal runs.

subject: Customer billed twice for same invoice
description: The same invoice was charged to the customer's card two times within an hour.
resolution: Confirmed a duplicate charge from a retried billing webhook. Refunded the duplicate charge and added an idempotency key to the billing webhook handler.

subject: Duplicate charge appears on billing statement
description: Customer's card statement shows the same subscription charge listed twice for this month.
resolution: Confirmed a duplicate charge caused by a billing job that ran twice after a deploy. Refunded the duplicate charge and added a guard against re-running the job.

subject: Invoice shows two identical charges
description: The invoice PDF lists the same line item and charge amount twice instead of once.
resolution: Confirmed a duplicate charge caused by the invoice generator double-counting a prorated add-on. Refunded the duplicate charge and fixed the invoice generator.
